role: Defines AssistantContext, the per-request snapshot of everything the assistant knows about the user, and its two renderers: compactRender() (full text dump for Apple on-device and no-tools fallbacks) and renderLiveStateForCloud() (today/yesterday/location <live_state> tail for cloud providers). Also global helpers formatNum and sleepEfficiencyClause.
types: AssistantContext: struct Codable — top-level context fields (generatedAt, userProfile, today, yesterday, yesterdayDiagnostic, recent, baselines, trends, analysisSummary, recentWorkouts, liveWorkout, liveHRVSession, ambientLocation)
toplevel: Struct declaration with Codable synthesis; liveWorkout, liveHRVSession, ambientLocation are var so AssistantContextSource overlays fresh broker data after build. The file comment claims 'Pure data — no analysis logic lives here', but rendering reads LiveWorkoutBroker.shared via AppDependencies (line 265) and the wall clock (lines 327, 743, 765).

flags.text: compactRender is documented as a pure render of the context ('Pure data', CompactRenderParityTests pins the output) yet liveWorkoutHRHistoryLines pulls samples from the global LiveWorkoutBroker and liveWorkoutBits/weeklyRollupLines/thirtyDayTotalLine use Date() instead of generatedAt, so the same AssistantContext renders differently depending on global state and time of render.

units.does: Builds the cloud <live_state> text: a today line (if any data), a yesterday line (recovery /100, RMSSD, mean HR) labelled by real wake day, and a '📍 LOCATION:' line only when a live workout is present and ambient location has bits; joined by newlines. `now` defaults to generatedAt. Called by AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:200 for tool-capable providers.

branches.effect: append yesterday line; else no yesterday line (a yesterday with score but no timeDomain is dropped entirely)
build location bits (privacy gate: outside a workout location is omitted); else no location line

units.does: Returns a day label for a session based on its wake date (endDate, else startDate) relative to now: 'TODAY:' / 'YESTERDAY:' or 'MOST RECENT, recorded yyyy-MM-dd (N days ago, NOT today):', with ' (<sessionType>)' appended for non-overnight sessions.

branches.cond: wake is same calendar day as now
wake is same calendar day as now − 1 day

branches.effect: use 0 days; then return MOST RECENT label with POSIX/gregorian yyyy-MM-dd date

units.does: Builds the first live-state line from `today`: day label plus recovery /100 with tier, RMSSD/SDNN/mean HR, overnight nadir/mean HR, sleep h/m with efficiency clause, and score message; nil when no today session or no data bits beyond the label.

branches.effect: return nil; else return joined line

units.does: Concatenates placeBits and motionBits for an ambient location snapshot.
Builds place fragments from an AmbientLocationSnapshot: 'on road', 'near cross' (if different from road), 'in locality', '(subdivision)' (if different from locality), administrative area, country.
Builds motion fragments: 'heading <cardinal> (<deg>°)', speed m/s and km/h when ≥0, 'alt Nm', 'GPS ±Nm' when >0, '(Ns old)'.

branches.effect: append speed; negative (invalid CoreLocation speed) skipped

units.does: Builds the '📍 LIVE LOCATION:' line from a LiveWorkoutSnapshot's road, cross street, locality, heading, speed and GPS accuracy; empty array if none present.

branches.effect: append speed m/s and km/h (no negative-speed check unlike motionBits:213)
return []; else one LIVE LOCATION line

units.does: Fetches live workout samples from the global LiveWorkoutBroker (AppDependencies.current.assistant.liveWorkoutBroker → LiveWorkoutBroker.shared unless overridden), and if ≥6 samples, summarises the last ≤600 into HR buckets for a '📈 LIVE HR HISTORY' line. The `live` parameter is unused.

branches.cond: bucket summaries empty (no HR in any bucket)
branches.effect: return []; else return one history line

flags.text: Reads live samples from the process-wide LiveWorkoutBroker at render time instead of from the AssistantContext it renders, so a context captured during a workout and rendered later (or in tests) shows whatever the broker holds now; the `live` argument is ignored.

units.does: Splits the sample window into min(6, max(2, n/60)) equal buckets and returns 'a–bm min/avg/max' per bucket from offsetSec and non-nil heartRate; buckets with no HR are skipped.

branches.effect: true: extend to end of window; false: perBucket boundary

units.does: Returns the live-workout block: '🟢 LIVE WORKOUT: ...' line plus live location line and HR-history line; empty when no liveWorkout. The formatter parameter is unused.

Builds live-workout fragments: sport, minutes elapsed, snapshot_age_sec (now − snapshotAt, from Date()), HR with % of userMaxHR, peak HR, distance, steps, and α1 value/band or 'α1 unavailable: <status>'.

branches.effect: append HR (with % of max when userMaxHR > 0)
true: compute percent; false: nil percent
append α1 value and band; else 'α1 unavailable: <alpha1Status>'

units.does: Builds the '🟢 LIVE RECORDING:' line from liveHRVSession: phase description, minutes elapsed, beat count, collecting/not collecting, last error.
Returns the '📍 LOCATION:' line from ambientLocation when includeAmbientLocation is true (privacy gate for cloud renders) and bits exist.
Builds 'Profile: ...' line (age, sex, fitness level, VO2max, maxHR, units, on-break, training goal) when any present, followed by the algorithm line.

branches.effect: append Profile line; else only algorithm line

units.does: Builds the algorithm description line: version with hard-coded tier weights (T3 60/25/15, T2 70/30, T1 HRV only), Comeback mode day N of 21 and weight shift when active, and a not-yet-recomputed warning.

branches.effect: append 'Score history NOT yet recomputed' warning

flags.text: Tier weights (60/25/15, 70/30) and Comeback weights are hard-coded prose here, separate from RecoveryScoreCalculator's constants and AppKnowledgeBase.reference, so a weight change must be edited in three places.

The algorithm line tells the model Tier 2 is always 'HRV 70% / Sleep 30%', but ScoreDetailBuilder.buildTier2 switches to HRV 85% / Sleep 15% when the HRV z-score < -1 and sleep < 50; on those nights the assistant explains the score with the wrong weights. The reference text in AppKnowledgeBase does not mention the dampened case either.

units.does: Returns the today-session block (header, ISO start date, score, physiology, load/feeling lines) or [] when no today session.
Returns 'Recovery score: N/100 (Tier T)' and 'Coach note: ...' lines for a session when present.
Concatenates today's HRV, overnight HR and sleep lines.
Returns 'HRV: RMSSD .. SDNN .. mean HR ..' when timeDomain present.

flags.text: Same HRV line text is built again inline in yesterdayMetricLines.

units.does: Returns 'Overnight HR: nadir N bpm [at h:mm a], range a–b, mean m' when overnightHR present.

flags.text: Near-copy of overnightHRLine (A:547) differing only by the trailing mean; two formatters for the same fact.

units.does: Returns 'Sleep: Hh Mm, efficiency ..[ (short)][ (fragmented)]' when sleep present.
Returns training-load line (ATL, CTL, TSB, optional ACWR) and self-rated feeling 'N/5 (label)' lines.

branches.effect: append feeling with label clamped to 1..5 index

flags.text: Training line duplicates trainingLoadLine (A:558) minus the prior-day TRIMP suffix.

units.does: Returns the yesterday block (header, ISO date, metric lines) and the 'Yesterday's summary: title — explanation' line from yesterdayDiagnostic.

branches.effect: append header, date and metric lines
append summary line (rendered even when yesterday is nil, without a header)

units.does: Returns yesterday's score, HRV, overnight HR, sleep, training-load and feeling lines, each only when present.
Formats 'Overnight HR: nadir N bpm [at h:mm a], range a–b'.
Formats 'Training: ATL, CTL, TSB[, ACWR], prior-day TRIMP'.
Returns up to 5 overnight sessions from `recent` dated before yesterday's (or today's) startDate, one line each, under an 'Earlier sessions' header.

branches.effect: cutoff = distantFuture so all overnight sessions qualify; else cutoff = (yesterday ?? today).startDate

units.does: Formats one earlier session: date then each present field (score /100, RMSSD, HR, sleep, deep, REM, dip, TSB, ACWR, trimp >0, feel).
Returns the personal-baseline block (header with daysInWindow, RMSSD/SDNN/mean HR/stress-index baselines when present).
Returns the 7-day trend block: header with data-point count, overall trend, and first 4 metric trend lines.
Formats one metric trend: 'name: mean x, trend[, d% vs baseline]'.
Returns the analysis summary block: title — explanation, then up to 3 probable causes, key findings and actionable steps.

Returns one ' · '-joined line per workout in the window plus an indented note line when workoutFeelingNote is non-empty. Uses a DateFormatter with only dateFormat 'yyyy-MM-dd' (device calendar/locale).

flags.text: Date formatter sets no locale/calendar, unlike earlierSessionLines and liveStateDayLabel which pin en_US_POSIX + gregorian; on a device using a non-Gregorian calendar (e.g. Buddhist, Japanese) workout dates are rendered with that calendar's year (e.g. 2569) while session dates use Gregorian, so the model sees inconsistent dates.

units.does: Formats one workout as bits: date, sport, duration, distance km (≥100 m), pace m:ss/km, avg/max HR, TRIMP, HRSS, decoupling, METs, kcal, elevation (>5 m), plus sensor bits.
Formats power/cadence/α1/HRR/feeling bits for a workout, each only when present.
Returns the recent-workouts block: blank line, weekly rollup, detail lines for the first 14 workouts, and a '(+ N older — call workout.list...)' line when more exist.
Builds the rollup header: last-N-shown count and 7-day totals (sessions, km, minutes, TRIMP) computed against Date(), the 7-day sport mix, and the 30-day total line.
Returns '30-day total: N sessions, X km' when the 30-day count exceeds the 7-day count, else nil; window measured from Date().

Renders the full compact context text: header, live workout, live HRV, ambient location (gated by includeAmbientLocation, default true), profile+algorithm, today, yesterday, earlier sessions, baselines, 7-day trend, summary, recent workouts; newline-joined. Called by AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:511 (Apple only, default gate) and AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:644 (no-tools fallback, gate = apple || liveWorkout != nil).

flags.text: includeAmbientLocation defaults to true (fail-open): the privacy gate for cloud-bound renders depends on every cloud caller remembering to pass the disclosure-matched value; today the only cloud-capable caller (fallbackContextRender) does, and Routing:511 renders only for Apple, but a new caller using the default would send street-level location to a cloud provider outside a workout.

units.does: Global helper: formats a Double with a fixed number of decimal digits via String(format: "%.<n>f"). Called only from AssistantContext.swift renderers (grep finds no other file calling formatNum).
Global helper: returns 'efficiency N%' from SleepSnapshot.sleepEfficiency×100, or 'efficiency not measured' when nil.
